svg.title: Robot motion planning: current class architecture and execution threads
svg.desc: Unity controller calls a compatibility dispatcher. Six concrete planners inherit a shared plain C# base; Fast and Optimized RRT-Connect also inherit a shared tree engine. Four joint-space searches and grid snapshot search use workers. Unity scene queries, grid robot validation, Cartesian Arc, visualization, and execution use the main thread.
svg.text: Current C# architecture · controller, six algorithms, and execution threads
returns a concrete planner as the base type
PLAIN C# · dispatcher + shared data types
Kind → CreatePlanner() → concrete TryPlan(); existing callers use this entry point.
SHARED INPUT · nested type of the dispatcher
Collision / IK / FK callbacks; joint limits and costs
SHARED OUTPUT · returned to the controller
Joint path / TCP route; iterations, failure details
ABSTRACT C# BASE · all six planners
ABSTRACT C# BASE · shared tree expansion
Stops at the first valid connection
CONCRETE · compare and refine joint routes
TCP travel + J6 penalty; safe roll refinement
IK branches + swept joint collision checks
Instantiate any concrete planner with World.
All six are ordinary C# classes; no GameObject is required.
Start / goal / via poses → valid IK branches
Copy joint limits; cache colliders; create World
Fast / Optimized RRT-Connect, PRM, Informed RRT*
Controller dispatches to the selected C# class
TCP speed, replay, travel time, iteration status
Rig angles, Physics, collider separation, FK
Scene access runs here; request results go back
Worker waits for each required scene-query result
Search loop resumes after the main-thread answer
Progress + cancellation are carried by World.
Returned Result includes the saved joint path.
Grid A*: capture a value snapshot
Grid cell size, start / goal, forbidden cells
Build occupancy map → A* → TCP route
Static entry uses copied data only
Accept joint path, or reject and request another route
Rejected grid route → forbid a cell → retry
Cartesian Arc · currently runs on the Unity main thread
Controller → dispatcher → CartesianArcPlanner: arc sampling, IK, and collider callbacks execute synchronously.
The planner classes execute on their caller’s thread; the controller supplies the runtime scheduling.
